CHAPTER 03 / 05 CONTENT DEVELOPMENT & ACQUISITIONS

A story instinct.
A production perspective.

I understand what it takes for an idea to become a finished film. That perspective is what I would bring to an OTT content team.

WHY THIS ROLE

Recognise the promise.
Develop the material.
Understand the path to screen.

My experience is in filmmaking, writing and production. I’m looking to apply that foundation to content development and acquisitions: evaluating stories, helping creators sharpen their material, and contributing an informed view of execution.

01

Read for the story.

EXPERIENCE I BRING

Concept development, research, screenwriting and dialogue.

HOW I WOULD APPLY IT

I would assess premise, character, structure, tone and audience promise, then translate that reading into specific, useful development notes.

02

See the series, not just the pilot.

EXPERIENCE I BRING

Full-season writing and direction on Thulasivanam.

HOW I WOULD APPLY IT

I would look for a sustainable character engine, an evolving world and an episode arc that can support the intended format.

03

Connect ambition to execution.

EXPERIENCE I BRING

On-set coordination, producer responsibilities and post supervision.

HOW I WOULD APPLY IT

I would bring production awareness to creative discussions: casting needs, locations, schedule pressures and the effect of early decisions on delivery.

04

Bring a local point of view.

EXPERIENCE I BRING

Hands-on work in Telugu features and original streaming content.

HOW I WOULD APPLY IT

I would contribute cultural context and a filmmaker’s reading of voice, authenticity and the potential for stories to travel.

05

Make the pitch tangible.

EXPERIENCE I BRING

Loglines, treatments, beat sheets, bibles and visual development.

HOW I WOULD APPLY IT

I can help shape clear pitch materials, mood references and development documents, using AI-assisted previs to explore and communicate options.

MY APPROACH TO A CONTENT RECOMMENDATION

Clarity before
commitment.

01 / The creative case

What is the hook? Whose story is it? Why this format, and why would someone keep watching?

02 / The development path

What works already? What needs rewriting? Which creative collaborators could help the material grow?

03 / The practical questions

What must be understood about the production, delivery and rights position before a recommendation progresses?

This is my proposed approach to the role. Commercial negotiations, rights clearance and acquisition deal execution are not claimed as prior credits.

WORKING TOOLKIT

Tools that serve the story.

Final Draft / Celtx / Premiere Pro / Final Cut Pro / Canva

AI-assisted ideation and previs: ChatGPT / Sora / Midjourney / Runway / Suno / ElevenLabs
